name: web-dark-data-table-with-status-pills-and-total-row
title: Dark bordered card table 'Team Contributors' with name, email, location, status pills and payout, and a total row
whatItIs: A black rounded card with a bold title, grey column headers, five rows separated by hairlines with names in bold, emails, locations, status pills (green Active, grey Inactive, yellow Pending) and right-aligned rupee payouts, a slightly lighter Total row and a centred grey caption.
whatItMeans: Clear and calm; small tonal pills make status readable without heavy colour.

vocabulary.definition: A small coloured capsule showing state.
A summary row with a slightly different tone.
Numbers aligned to the right edge.
A small line describing the table.
